Many successful people have the habit of waking up early, such as Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, former U.S. First Lady Michelle Obama, talk show queen Oprah Winfrey, Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey, and bestselling author Timothy Ferriss. Of course, you don’t have to imitate them exactly. But if you want to change your gloomy daily routine or need a turning point in your life, the simplest and fastest way to start is by changing your morning time. Attorney Kim Yu-jin, who holds law licenses in two U.S. states, transformed millions of mornings in Korea with her morning routine method. By learning this method, you too can create a life-changing turning point in the five seconds after your alarm rings and the two hours before work
